title: Kabus - Psychological Horror
description: A psychological horror mod that shatters your sanity and stalks you from the shadows. Face custom DFS labyrinths, armor-piercing entities, and dark rituals in Minecraft 1.20.1
body:
This mod is currently in its early beta stage. Features are functional, but you may encounter bugs. Please report any issues in the comments!

#  About Kabus: The Nightmare Mod
"Kabus" is an immersive psychological horror mod built around a dynamic **Sanity System** for Minecraft 1.20.1 (Forge). Darkness is no longer just a lack of light—it is a threat to your mind. As your sanity drains, the world around you will begin to fracture, forcing you to question what is real and what is a hallucination.

## Core Features:
* **Dynamic Sanity HUD:** Track your mental state with a custom hotbar overlay that shakes and turns red as paranoia sets in.
* **Environmental Sanity:** Staying in pitch-black areas, sprinting, being low on health, or caught in the rain will drain your sanity. Holding a Flashlight or staying near campfires/pets will help restore it.
* **The "Kabus" Entity:** A terrifying, tall, shadow-like stalker with glowing white eyes. It destroys blocks in its path to reach you, but it plays by psychological rules—approaching faster when your back is turned and vanishing when stared at.

## Advanced Horror & Uncertainty Systems:
1. **Shadow Figures:** Spot distant humanoid silhouettes wearing random skins—or even your own. They vanish when approached or directly observed (<30% Sanity).
2. **Inventory Hallucinations:** Distorted item counts, swapped textures, or valuable ores looking like stone (visual only, actual items are safe).
3. **Mimic Sound System:** Hear fake Creeper hisses, footsteps, breaking blocks, or opening doors right behind you.
4. **Nightmare Sleep Event:** Trying to sleep with critically low sanity might trigger sudden wake-ups, glowing eyes, and terrifying sounds.
5. **Uncertainty System:** Reaching 0% sanity won't always spawn the monster. Sometimes it’s just blindness, sometimes it's pure silence. You will never know if you are truly safe.
6. **Name Whispering:** Dynamic spatial audio that literally whispers YOUR Minecraft username in the dark, paired with faint gray [Whisper] chat messages.
7. **Reality Distortion:** Experience rare, client-side visual anomalies like blood moons, inverted trees, or screen-inverting shader effects (`invert.json`).
8. **Disturbing Notes:** Stumble upon extremely rare notes left in the world reading: *"don't look behind you"*, *"it knows"*, or *"stop running"*.
9. **Adaptive AI & Psychological Tracking:** Kabus tracks your movements and how many times you look behind, changing its hunting patterns based on your behavior.

## 🛠️ Crafting Recipes
It is highly recommended to use **JEI (Just Enough Items)** to see all crafting recipes in-game for items like the Flashlight and Calming Syrup.



Kabus Mod v2.0.0 — Major Update
 Dungeon Combat Arena
Rooms now spawn monster waves when you enter them
Iron doors between rooms stay locked until the wave is cleared

 Boss Summon System
Type anything with "come" in chat to summon the Nightmare Boss
A red countdown shows on screen: THE NIGHTMARE is coming in 5...
60-second cooldown between summons
 Flashlight & Battery
New Battery item found in camp and tower chests
Press R to recharge your flashlight
Flashlight flickers when below 25% charge
 Hallucinations
Low sanity causes fake ores (diamond/gold) to appear in the world
Ghost chests spawn nearby — they vanish when you get close
 Simon Says Event
1.5 seconds to react — fail and you get punished
Moving your camera also counts as moving during DON'T MOVE
Collection Challenge
Random event: a chest spawns nearby with a sign saying "Put Items Here"
You have a time limit to gather and deposit the required items

 Kabus Realm
A dark dimension made of floating obsidian islands in the void
Activate 3 Ancient Altars scattered across the realm to break the shield around the Heart of Nightmare
Destroy the Heart to purify the world and end the nightmare forever
Low gravity, random levitation, and shadow hands punish you for standing still
 Misc
New hidden clues added to the starter book
